claims.title: Defining-prime integral normalization and complete Smith classification
claims.statement: For every positive integral witness at p congruent to 1 modulo 12 with p not dividing S, the original rank-eight signed quartic has the displayed normalization matrix. The one-divisible and two-divisible denominator strata have the complete Smith formulas (17) and (20); the separated E and M states specialize exactly to exponents (0,0,0,0,0,0,1,1) and (0,0,0,1,1,2,2,3), hence indices p^2 and p^9.

claims.title: Exact translated-chart twist and fixed-prime collision gluing
claims.statement: The p-dividing-S translated chart is a quadratic twist: after q^2=S/(S-4 lambda), T_lambda maps to T_0-lambda and sigma_lambda maps to q sigma_0; descent over Q_p requires the square-class condition. On the fixed-prime base the signed algebra is the exact rank-2 plus rank-6 fibre product over B/(R)[sigma]/(sigma^2). Its collision model B[zeta]/(zeta^4-t^2) has normalization Smith exponents (0,0,1,1), specialization kernel generated by zeta^2,zeta^3, and the fixed Gamma metric has the proved kernel minimum and covariance scales 1, |t|, |t|^2, |t|^3.

claims.title: Local signed-label representation and conductor-index identity
claims.statement: For a residue cluster C of m labels, the signed-label defect representation is 1^(m-1) plus the m quadratic characters of the normalized factors. It is tame, its Artin conductor is the sum of the parity exponents epsilon_i, and 2 length(normalization/original)+a(W)=6 sum_{i<j} v_p(t_i-t_j). The separated exterior pair has 1 plus two copies of chi_{pD_E}; the p=1201 middle witness has Frobenius polynomial (1-T)^3(1+T)^2 and trace one while retaining integral defect length nine.

nonclaims: The translated chart is not identified with the original signed algebra over Q_p without the square-class descent.
A nonreduced special fibre is not an Erdős--Straus counterexample.
Local Frobenius is not identified with a complex zeta operator.
